Kibble.Monitoring.StatusMonitor module¶

Defines an interface for the StatusMonitor

class Kibble.Monitoring.StatusMonitor.StatusMonitor(endpoints: list[dict] = [], timeout: int = 10)¶

Bases: ABC

Base class that monitors that status of a computer

add_endpoint(additional: list[dict] = []) → list[str]¶
Adds additional endpoints to be monitored. If an endpoint already

exists, it will be overwritten

Parameters:

endpoints – a list of IP addresses to monitor. Should follow same rules as __init__

Returns:

the updated list of endpoint IDs

get_endpoints() → list[str]¶
get_status() → dict¶

Retrieves a copy of the status of the endpoints since the last time they were checked.

Returns:

a dictionary with endpoints as keys. The value should be another dict with the key “alive” with True or False and the key “last_updated” with the value of the UNIX timestamp in milliseconds of when the entry was updated. If the endpoint has not been probed yet, the value of its key will be None. The rest of thefields can be any additional information depending on the implementation.

remove_endpoint(removal: list[str]) → list[str]¶

Removes an endpoint from monitoring. If an endpoint doesn’t exist, it will be skipped.

Parameters:

removal – list of ids to remove from monitoring

Returns:

the updated list of endpoints
